title: Halliday Watkins Mann
description: hwmlawfirm.com zoominfo.com/c/halliday--watkins--mann-pc/42929145 Halliday, Watkins & Mann, P.C. (HWM) is a Salt Lake City-based law firm founded in 1935, now operating as a fourth-generation family practice. The firm exclusively serves the mortgage banking industry, specializing in creditor remedies such as foreclosures, bankruptcies, replevins, evictions, and REO closings. With a team of 51–200 employees, HWM provides full-service legal support and title curative work to financial institutions across multiple states
